label: cell body or cytoplasmic projection contraction
definition: A physiological phenotype in which a microbial cell actively contracts its body or a cytoplasmic projection, reducing its length or extension.
observations: Shortening parent; refined parents for existing v558/v604 child IDs.

label: rapid axopodial contraction
definition: A physiological phenotype in which a microbial cell rapidly shortens its microtubule-supported axopodia in response to stimulation or prey uptake.
observations: Rapid axopodial shortening; no universal calcium threshold or protein mechanism. Existing ID; v605 supplies the refined direct parent.

label: cell-body contraction
definition: A physiological phenotype in which a microbial cell actively shortens its body by contraction of intracellular structures.
observations: Active shortening of the microbial cell body; no universal speed or protein mechanism. Existing ID; v605 supplies the refined direct parent.
